Vitesse en palier au régime de croisière: Level flight speed at cruise power.
Altitude maximale atteignable — au-delà,: Maximum reachable altitude — beyond it, the air is too thin to sustain flight.
Distance franchissable avec le plein de: Distance covered on a full fuel load.
Masse totale divisée par la surface alai: Total mass divided by wing area. Lower means tighter turns; too high undermines reliability (structural overload).
Agilité en vol — pèse dans les concours: In-flight agility — matters in fighter tenders and armament criteria.
Chance de tenir en service sans incident: Chance of staying in service without incident. Below 65%, a crash becomes possible each quarter delivered; above 72%, every delivery builds reputation.
Nombre de sièges — dérivé de la charge u: Number of seats — derived from payload, relevant to civil segments.
Cellule + moteur + équipements + carbura: Airframe + engine + equipment + fuel + payload, at takeoff.
Ce que coûte à construire UN exemplaire: What it costs to build ONE unit — market margin is sale price minus this value.
Coût d'usage estimé (carburant, entretie: Estimated running cost (fuel, upkeep) — factors into civil segment scoring, where airlines watch their pennies.
Prix à payer pour lancer la campagne d'e: Price to pay to launch this design's flight-test campaign.
Durée de la campagne d'essais en vol ava: Duration of the flight-test campaign before the aircraft can enter service.
Biplan : deux ailes plus petites, plus d: Biplane: two smaller wings, more drag but a lighter airframe and better handling. Monoplane: faster, the modern layout from 1930 on.
Bois : léger et bon marché. Mixte : comp: Wood: light and cheap. Mixed: a compromise. Metal (monocoque, requires the tech): heavier and pricier airframe but sturdier and more reliable — the way of the future.
Détermine puissance, masse, consommation: Determines power, mass, fuel burn and base reliability. Only engines available this year (and from your partner maker, if any) are listed.
Plus grande, elle porte davantage (plafo: Larger, it carries more (ceiling, payload) but drags more (speed) — the central design trade-off.
Détermine l'autonomie. Alourdit l'appare: Determines range. Adds weight: more fuel costs speed and handling.
Passagers ou fret transportable (90 kg =: Passengers or cargo carried (90 kg = 1 passenger). Adds to total mass just like fuel.
Nombre d'armes fixes montées. Alourdit e: Number of fixed guns fitted. Adds weight and drag, but counts in military criteria and Specifications.
Le marché sur lequel ce design sera vend: The market this design will sell into — each segment judges different criteria (see MARKET RATING below).
Prix de vente unitaire au segment choisi: Unit sale price for the chosen segment. Pre-filled at cost × 1.25; adjustable once launched, from the Market screen.
Paie le coût du prototype et ouvre une c: Pays the prototype cost and opens a flight-test campaign. Defects may be revealed at the end — fix them or enter service as-is before selling.
Jette les brouillons de conception qu'au: Discards design drafts no product on sale still needs — otherwise they'd pile up forever in the save.
Un archétype débloqué (combo de technos: An unlocked archetype (a mastered tech combo) loads a full airframe preset — layout, structure, equipment — which you can then freely adjust.
Repart de la cellule d'un design existan: Starts from an existing design's airframe (layout/structure/area locked, engine and equipment free): prototype and design work at a discount — the real story of aircraft lineages.
Chercher AVANT l'état de l'art mondial (: Researching AHEAD of the world state of the art (a PIONEER bet) costs 4× more and takes 2× longer, but grants a 3-year patent if you're first. After: cost ×0.6 (follower), no patent possible. Click a technology for details.
Pari pionnier : personne au monde ne maî: Pioneer bet: no one in the world has mastered this tech yet. Cost ×%d and duration ×%d, but a 3-year patent is yours if you finish first — rivals will pay royalties.
Un rival a breveté cette techno en premi: A rival patented this tech first. Researching it directly works around the patent (duration ×%.1f); a licence buys the right immediately, no workaround needed.
Achète immédiatement le droit d'utiliser: Immediately buys the right to use this rival-patented tech — no research time, cash for time saved.
Affecte cet ingénieur à un poste : Étude: Assigns this engineer to a post: Design (speeds up and discounts the prototype), Research (speeds up the Lab), Workshop (raises production capacity). Unassigned = contributes nothing.
Renvoie cet ingénieur — coûte une indemn: Dismisses this engineer — costs a severance of several weeks' salary.
Embauche ce candidat — salaire hebdomada: Hires this candidate — weekly salary due as soon as assigned to a post. The pool refreshes periodically and improves with the years.
Bonus cumulés de l'équipe, selon compéte: Combined team bonuses, from skill + matching trait × morale of each assigned engineer. Research: Lab speed. Prototype: discount on prototyping cost. Workshop: extra production capacity.
Le vainqueur reçoit un acompte à la clôt: The winner receives an advance at closing, then delivers the series quarter by quarter with PRIORITY in the workshop. The price per aircraft is FIXED — too high a production cost makes winning ruinous.
This criterion's weight in the final score. Your score on it = your value / the reference (inverted if "less = better"), capped, then multiplied by the weight.
Estimation live selon les critères ci-de: Live estimate from the criteria above, weighted by your domain reputation. The best score above the threshold wins — rivals also enter with their own hardware.
Dépose ce produit comme candidature — gr: Submits this product as an entry — free, replaceable until closing. The winner is determined automatically at the closing date.
Le culot augmente les chances de succès: Nerve raises a raid's odds of success. A hired pilot draws a weekly salary and risks their life on every attempt.
Raid : succès selon l'autonomie de l'app: Raid: success depends on the aircraft's range, its reliability and the pilot's nerve — failure may cost the aircraft, even the pilot. Race: your speed (weighted by reliability) against the best rival, no risk of loss.
Course : votre vitesse (pondérée par la: Race: your speed (weighted by reliability) against the best rival aircraft — no risk of losing the aircraft or pilot.
Cette série se construit trimestre par t: This series is built quarter by quarter, with PRIORITY in the workshop slots — also visible on the Market screen, Workshop section.
Raye ce modèle de la vente. Le stock au: Strikes this model off sale. Hangar stock is quietly liquidated at second-hand rates (½ price), with no reputation effect.
Solde TOUT le carnet en attente (%d comm: Sells off the ENTIRE pending backlog (%d orders) to colonial airlines at half price, cash now — and pulls the product from sale. Costs %d pt of reputation.
Livré : unités remises aux clients le de: Delivered: units handed to customers last quarter. Share: % of the segment you capture. Backlog: orders awaiting production, delivered over coming quarters (or cancelled if too old).
Hangar : appareils déjà construits, livr: Hangar: aircraft already built, delivered IMMEDIATELY on order without using workshop capacity. In workshop: order under construction, ready next quarter if capacity allows.
Commande 5 appareils supplémentaires pou: Orders 5 more aircraft for the hangar — built on remaining workshop capacity, paid for on construction. A backlog covered by stock delivers instantly, which improves your market share.
Prime hebdomadaire par produit au catalo: Weekly premium per product in the catalogue. In exchange, a crash costs half as much: backlog ×0.75 instead of ×0.5, reputation −2 pts instead of −4.
Revenu chaque trimestre pour chaque appa: Revenue every quarter for each aircraft still in service (delivered in the last 3 years), proportional to its reliability. A reliable aircraft pays twice: at sale, then in maintenance.
Des intérêts sont prélevés chaque semain: Interest is charged weekly on the remaining debt. The ceiling the bank will lend follows your reputation (civil or military, whichever is higher).
Ajoute 100 000 £ (ou le reste du plafond: Adds 100,000 £ (or the remaining ceiling if less) to cash immediately, against weekly interest on the debt.
Rembourse jusqu'à 100 000 £ de dette (li: Repays up to 100,000 £ of debt (limited by available cash), reducing weekly interest.
Engagement À VIE, irréversible. Tous les: LIFELONG commitment, irreversible. All %s engines cost −%d %%; the rival maker's engines vanish from your catalogue.
Le plafond suit votre réputation. En cri: The ceiling tracks your reputation. In a crisis, the bank may recall its due.
Un accident sur produit fragile amortit: A crash on a fragile product cushions reputation and backlog.
La fiabilité paie deux fois — en revenu: Reliability pays twice — in revenue and in risk.
Un 5e emplacement de catalogue + un débo: A 5th catalogue slot + a captive outlet — the late-game money sink.
Par trimestre : marge ventes (+) · charg: Per quarter: sales margin (+) · fixed costs (−) · other (±) · balance
Sauvegarde auto à chaque trimestre, sur: Auto-save every quarter, to the active slot.
Sûr ? La partie en cours sera perdue: Sure? The current game will be lost
%s en essais en vol — %d sem. Pas encore: %s in flight testing — %d wk. Not yet on sale: follow it in the Design Office.
Essais terminés — %s · %s. Mettre en ser: Testing complete — %s · %s. Enter service in the Design Office to sell.
La boucle : concevoir un avion au Bureau: The loop: design an aircraft in the Design Office (the MARKET RATING says whether it will sell), pay for the prototype and follow it through FLIGHT TESTING (defects may appear — fix them or live with them), then put it into service in a segment: the market buys EVERY QUARTER (summary in the top bar). Watch the Market (demand, rivals — they fight back), the Tenders, the Staff and the Lab. The prototype is dear: keep enough to carry on. Cash in the RED for 8 weeks = bankruptcy. Switch to ×4 to begin.
Personne sur le marché — prochaine fourn: No one on the market — next batch soon.
